content: Yesu boda ꞌiheꞌaidiya
Sauga nage ꞌoina boda madouna wete sihegogonama Yesu ꞌoina, ma geya ꞌadimo. Coinega ꞌana tomuliyao ꞌibwauwedima, ma ꞌihegwaediya, ꞌigwae,
“Tomota bewa yaꞌate muyamuyaediya, weyahina sabwelo ꞌetoi ꞌebwa baꞌidadao tamiyamiya, ma geya ꞌadimo.
Ceguma magomaledi yahesumanedi, tabu ma ꞌedai sihemwalomwalohana, weyahina tupwadi bwagebwagega sitauyama.”
Eeta Yesu ꞌana tomuliyaowedi sihegwaeya, sigwae, “Togidega tupwa yoho ꞌawawa ꞌoina tomotaedi bewa ꞌadi taloba ꞌese?”
Coinega Yesu ꞌihesilalediya, ꞌigwae, “Hisa ꞌami belediyao simiyamiya?” Ma sigwae, “Sebenimo.”

Eeta boda ꞌiloinediya ma baleꞌuwa simiyatoiya. Simiyatoiya ma beledi sebeniyedi ꞌiꞌewediya ma weyahidi ꞌiloyauwedowa Yehoba ꞌoina, ma ꞌiꞌehisihisiya, ꞌiꞌebwaediya ꞌana tomuliyao ꞌoidiya, ma tomota siꞌebwaediya, eema siheguyai sakowasiyeya.
Ma wete tupwana silahana ꞌiꞌiudi simiyamiya, weyahidi Yesu ꞌigwae helauwa Yehoba ꞌoina, ma ꞌana tomuliyaowedi ꞌiloinediya, ma siheguyaiyedi tomota ꞌoidiya.
Coinega mabwaiyadi siꞌaiya ta simwausuwa, ma muliyetega ꞌeꞌahai tupwatupwadi sidomweya ma kodo sebeni silohemahediya.
Ma bodaedi ꞌadi baibaiwa gide powa tausani. Eeta ꞌihewasa hilediya.
Tuta nage ꞌoina ꞌana tomuliyao baꞌidanao ꞌidi waga sigeluwa ma sinaowa Dalimanuta tupwaina.
Palisiyao nuwanuwadi ꞌilaꞌilala siꞌita
Eeta Palisiyao sinaoma, ma Yesu ꞌoina siheꞌoheꞌohena, ma sitohoya ma ꞌabehega galewega ꞌilaꞌilala ꞌida heꞌitae ꞌoidiya.
Ma Yesu maꞌina nuwagala ꞌihegwaediya ꞌigwae, “Togidega ma ꞌoinega yaso bewa nuwanuwami ꞌilaꞌilala, ma hesi geya ꞌeta waꞌita.”
Coinega ꞌiꞌebesinediya ma wagai ꞌigeluwa, ma sihabala hali tupwa.
Helodi ma Palisiyao ꞌidi heꞌita gide beledi ꞌana ꞌebe ꞌabiheseseha
Ma hesi ꞌadi haite sinuwanaideya, ma beledi ꞌaigeda tuwa wagai ꞌitupwa.
Ma Yesu ꞌihemataluwediya, ꞌigwae, “Waꞌita Palisiyao ma Helodi ꞌadi beledi ꞌana ꞌebe ꞌabiheseseha ꞌoinega waꞌita yahigomi.”
Coinega tomuliyaowedi siboidimo ꞌoidiya sigwaeya, “Yesu ꞌina gwaeina lamuna weyahina ꞌada haiteina tanuwanaideya.”

Ma Yesu ꞌidi nuwatuhu ꞌisanapuya, ꞌoinega ꞌihegwaediya, “Toꞌaha weyahina wagwaegwae ꞌabehega geya ꞌami haitemo? Beno geya weyahina taugu yagwaegwae. Togidega ꞌimi nuwatuhu siꞌelopota ma geya sawasawahina ma ꞌigu gwae lamuna wasanapu.
Mamatami ma geya waꞌita, ma wete matenami ma geya wada hesagoha, ꞌoinega geyaꞌabwa wanuwanuwa tuhuyahi ꞌigu paihowao boda ꞌadi heꞌai weyahina, ꞌawa?
Tutaina beledi nima ꞌoinega tomota paibi tausani yaheꞌaidiya hisa kodo ꞌulaheya ꞌoidiyega wahegogonediya?” Ma sigwae “Tuwelo.”
Ma Yesu ꞌihenaida wete ꞌigwaeya, “Ma tutaina beledi sebeni ꞌoinega tomota powa tausani yaheꞌaidiya, ma hisa kodo ꞌulaheya ꞌoidiyega wahegogoneya?” Ma sigwae, “Sebeni.”
Coinega Yesu ꞌigwaeya, “Comi togidega ta geya nuwami ꞌida sabwalena.”
Yesu tomata gibugibu ꞌiꞌabihe bwebweꞌaneya
Eeta Bedeseida ꞌoina sitauyama, ma loheya ꞌaigeda mata gibugibuina sitoeyama Yesu ꞌoina, siꞌahwanoiyeya ꞌabehega ꞌiꞌabitoho ma ꞌibwebweꞌana.

Coinega Yesu tomata gibugibuina nimana ꞌoina ꞌiꞌabiya ma ꞌitoeya, ꞌasaina siꞌebesineya. Ma Yesu loheyaina matana ꞌihulasiya, ma nimanega matanaina ꞌiꞌabitohodiya, ma ꞌihegwaeya, “Sawasawahina toꞌaha ꞌuꞌitadi?”
Coinega loheyaina ꞌiloꞌita dadana ma ꞌigwaeya, “Tomota yaꞌitediya, ma ꞌadi ꞌita gide tuwa ꞌaiwe siꞌeꞌelo yawala.”
Ma wete Yesu loheyaina matana ꞌiꞌabitoho hilediya, ma ꞌiꞌebubuna, eeta ꞌiꞌasilala bwaibwaina, ma ginaula mabwaiyadi ꞌiꞌitediya.
Coinega Yesu ꞌihewasaeya, ꞌigwae, “Geyaꞌabwa ꞌuhilahila ꞌasa madouna ꞌoina, ma hesi ꞌutauya ꞌuboi ꞌino hada.”
Pita ꞌihepwaila Yesu weyahina
Ta Yesu maꞌana tomuliyao sinaonao Sisaliya Pilipai tupwaidi weyahidi ma ꞌedai ꞌana tomuliyaowedi ꞌihegwaediya, ꞌigwae, “Togidega tomota ꞌidi gwae weyahigu wahesagohediya ꞌabehega taiya taugu?”
Ma tomuliyaowedi sigwae, “Tomota tupwadi sigwaeya ꞌabehega ꞌowa Yoni Toꞌabihebabitaiso, ma wete tupwadi sigwae ꞌabehega ꞌowa Ilaitiya, ma tupwadi sigwae ꞌabehega ꞌowa palopita nugenugetaina ꞌaigeda.”
Coinega wete ꞌihesilalediya, “Ma ꞌomi togidega ꞌimi nuwatuhu ꞌabehega taugu taiya?” Eema Pita ꞌihemaiseya ꞌigwae, “Cowa Keliso Toꞌabihetenaina.”
Ma Yesu ꞌiloina paꞌalediya, ꞌigwae, “Geya sawasawahina ꞌeta taiya ꞌoina wahehepwailegau.”
Yesu ꞌihepwaila ꞌina muya ma ꞌina ꞌamasa weyahidi

Ma Yesu ꞌiheꞌale ꞌiheꞌita ꞌoidiya toꞌaha ꞌabwa ꞌoina ꞌilatu, ma ꞌigwaeya, “Taugu Loheyaiguina ꞌabwa muya madouna yaloba. Weyahina babada ta topwaoli madoudi ta loina ꞌana toheꞌitao ꞌabwa silogwahategau ma siloheꞌamasigau, ma sabwelo ꞌetoi mulina ꞌabwa yatoholo hila.”

Yesu ꞌina gwaeina bewa ꞌoinega ꞌilagu hemasalaheya ꞌina ꞌamasa weyahina. Coinega Pita Yesu ꞌitoeya, ma mahetena sinaowa hagana, ma Pitaina ꞌiꞌausiya ma ꞌabehega ginauledi sahena silatulatu Yesu ꞌoina.

Ma Yesu ꞌihasakowasi ma ꞌana tomuliyao ꞌiꞌeꞌebubudiya, ma ꞌiheliya Pita ꞌoina, ꞌigwaeya, “Cowa Seitani, bewa sauga ꞌuꞌebesinegau! Weyahina ꞌino nuwatuhuwedi nuwatuhu ꞌasa gabulena ꞌana nuwatuhu, ma hesi geya Yehoba ꞌina nuwatuhu gide.”

Coinega Yesu boda mabwaiyadi ma wete ꞌana tomuliyao mahetediyao ꞌibwau heꞌautedima, ma ꞌihegwaediya, ꞌigwae, “Taiya ꞌeguma nuwanuwana ma ꞌimuliyegau, ꞌilobwaineya ma ꞌiboi ꞌina loina ꞌilogwahate, ma ꞌaneyage ꞌiboi ꞌana kelose ꞌiꞌahali ma ꞌiꞌamasa, beno gide ꞌana ꞌedaꞌeda, ꞌeguma taiya ꞌimuliyegau.”
Ma hesiyage ꞌeguma taiya yawasina ꞌinuwahi, ꞌabwa yawasinaina ꞌiheꞌwadalele. Ma ꞌeguma taiya weyahigu ma wasana bwebweꞌana weyahina yawasina ꞌitagwale ma ꞌiꞌamasa, tauna ꞌabwa yawasi moisa ꞌiloba.
Ma ꞌeguma ꞌida wasawasao baleꞌuwa madou hedadedi talobediya beno ginaula bwagabwaga, ma hesi ginaula madou hedada beno yawasida moisa.
Weyahina ꞌeguma yawasida moisa taheꞌwadalele, beno geya wete ꞌeta ꞌana hemiyalae ꞌimiyamiya.

“Ma ꞌeguma taiya ꞌowa weyahigu ꞌuhedeba mwadimwadina, wete ꞌigu heꞌitao weyahidi ꞌuhedeba mwadimwadina, ma ꞌuuhalegau yaso bewa galadi ma ganaganawalidi matadiya, ꞌabwa taugu Loheyaiguina wete yauhalego, tutaina Tamagu ꞌina wasawasa maemaedanaina ꞌoinega yahilama ma aneloseyao wete baꞌidagwao.”
